uniann_policy: latest origin/main pulled before every seed's UniAnn step
uniann_scaling: four-state vector scaling (fit on 3L validation), then UniAnn's own built-in coding-frame scaling (convert_coding_frame.pl)
caveat: chrxtrain: chrX is in the training set, so chrX AUPRC and UniAnn locus metrics are not held-out estimates.
